create_vertex_direct_embedder: create a VertexDirectEmbedder with a given number of vertices and embedding dimensions
reset_embedder_parameters: reset the VertexDirectEmbedder embeddings to zero using reset_parameters
forward_normalized_embeddings: call forward on VertexDirectEmbedder to get L2-normalized vertex embeddings as a tensor
load_embeddings_from_file: load precomputed vertex embeddings from a pickle file into the embedder
normalize_embedding_vectors: use normalize_embeddings utility to L2-normalize a tensor of embedding vectors
